clue.text: There's no time to finish the card-game, pet

indicators.note: no time means the letter standing for time is dropped from the game's name
to finish says the dropped letter sits at the close of the word

parts.note: piquet is an old two-handed card game

explanation.surface: Someone sulks because there is no time left to complete a hand of cards.
explanation.walkthrough: 'no' and 'to finish' together remove T from the end of PIQUET. 'Pet' is not an animal but a fit of sulking.
explanation.definitionFit: A pet is a fit of peevish sulking, the same as a fit of resentment or irritation.

clue.text: Breathe heavily and totter — after its bite?

definitions.text: Breathe heavily and totter — after its bite?

parts.words: Breathe heavily and totter — after its bite?
parts.note: the clue reads as instructions, but describes a victim gasping and staggering after being bitten by a snake whose first part means to breathe heavily

explanation.definitionFit: This venomous African viper inflates its body and hisses, and its bite leaves victims breathless and staggering.

clue.text: Share prices estimated, 50% out

indicators.note: 50% out means half the letters of the word for price estimates are dropped

parts.note: quotations are estimated prices

explanation.surface: Projected share prices are wrong by half.
explanation.walkthrough: QUOTATIONS has ten letters; losing half leaves the first five.
explanation.definitionFit: A quota is an allotted portion or share.

clue.text: See about Times newspapers in no uncertain terms

indicators.note: about means the see goes round the other pieces

parts.note: Ely is a cathedral city, a bishop's see
x is the multiplication sign, read as times
the press means newspapers

explanation.surface: Look at what The Times and other papers say plainly.
explanation.walkthrough: A see is a bishop's diocese; ELY in Cambridgeshire is the crossword favourite.
explanation.definitionFit: Expressly means explicitly and clearly stated.

clue.text: The cabaret is perplexing? In what way?

parts.note: floors means baffles or perplexes
how? asks in what way

explanation.surface: A puzzled spectator wonders how the cabaret act is meant to be understood.
explanation.definitionFit: A cabaret is a night-club entertainment staged on the floor among the tables.

clue.text: Means to follow just part of a course

indicators.note: to follow puts the word for means after the word for just

parts.note: fair means just
a way is a means

explanation.surface: Fair methods are required to track only some of a route.
explanation.walkthrough: 'course' is a golf course.
explanation.definitionFit: On a golf course the mown stretch between tee and green is one section.

clue.text: East German, wealthy, one ignoring threats

parts.note: Ost is German for east
rich means wealthy

explanation.surface: A rich East German pays no attention to danger.
explanation.definitionFit: This bird is proverbially said to bury its head in the sand rather than face danger.

clue.text: Ice in a drink is soothing

definitions.meaning: a drink served on the ... comes over ice cubes
calms by swaying gently, as with a baby

explanation.definitionFit: A drink over ice is served on these, and swaying a baby gently calms it.

clue.text: Nasty chill overcomes member in race to the top

indicators.note: overcomes in a down clue puts the first piece above the second
nasty says the letters of chill are spoilt and reshaped

parts.note: a limb is a member of the body

explanation.surface: A cyclist in a race to the summit is overwhelmed by a nasty cold in one limb.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nasty' signals the anagram, and in a down clue 'overcomes' means the first piece sits above the second.
explanation.definitionFit: A motor-sport or cycling event timed up a steep slope to its summit.

clue.text: You and I'll audition for a turn

indicators.note: audition means hearing, so the words are taken by their sound

parts.note: you and I will contracts to we'll

explanation.surface: Two performers will try out together for a slot in a show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turn' looks like a stage act, but it means a rotation.
explanation.definitionFit: A wheel is a rotation or revolution.

clue.text: An obvious trace of brogue

parts.note: brogue looks like an Irish accent, but it is a sturdy shoe, and the trace it leaves is the mark of its sole

explanation.surface: A listener detects an unmistakable hint of an Irish accent.
explanation.definitionFit: A brogue is a heavy shoe, and the mark a shoe leaves on the ground is the print of a foot.

clue.text: Produce what's considered, primarily, potential veal?

indicators.note: primarily asks for the opening letter of the word considered
potential veal is veal still to be formed, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A farmer wonders whether what a cow produces should be thought of as future veal.
explanation.walkthrough: C from 'considered' then an anagram of VEAL (LVE... reworked as ALVE), signalled by 'potential'.
explanation.definitionFit: To produce young, for a cow, is to give birth to a calf.

clue.text: Conscious of a disturbance from the passage

parts.note: a wake is the disturbed water left by a boat's passage

explanation.surface: Someone is aware of a commotion coming from the corridor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'passage' looks like a corridor, but it is a vessel's passage through water.
explanation.definitionFit: To be conscious is to be alert and not asleep.

clue.text: Why inconclusive claim is rubbished as fanciful?

indicators.note: inconclusive means the word why loses its final letter
rubbished means the words claim and is are trashed and reassembled

explanation.surface: Someone asks why an unfinished claim was dismissed as fantasy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inconclusive' drops Y from WHY to leave WH; 'rubbished' rearranges CLAIMIS into IMSICAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Fanciful ideas are playful and capricious, guided by fancy rather than reason.

clue.text: Posh girl — a brazen one abandoning husband for a composer

parts.note: a deb, a debutante, is an upper-class young woman

indicators.note: abandoning says the letter for husband is left out of the word for a brazen woman

parts.note: a hussy is a brazen, shameless woman

explanation.surface: A society girl, shameless, leaves her husband for a composer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'abandoning' signals the removal of the husband's letter; the dashes make 'a brazen one' look like a description of the girl.
explanation.definitionFit: Claude Debussy was a French composer of impressionist music.

clue.text: Less likely to be lost in translation

definitions.text: Less likely to be lost in translation

parts.words: Less likely to be lost in translation
parts.note: describes a person who speaks two languages and so follows meaning across them

explanation.definitionFit: Someone fluent in two languages is not baffled when talk switches between them.

clue.text: Daring entertainer who'd listened to popular single

indicators.note: listened to says the word who'd is taken by its sound

parts.note: who'd is said like the first syllable
in means fashionable or popular
I, the Roman numeral, is one

explanation.surface: A bold performer heard a hit single.
explanation.definitionFit: Harry Houdini was a famous escapologist, a performer of risky escape stunts.

clue.text: Old city Romans restored to host one star group

parts.note: Ur was an ancient city of Mesopotamia

indicators.note: to host means the reshaped letters take in the numeral one
restored means the letters of Romans are put back together differently

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: In an ancient city, Romans rebuilt quarters to house a single star.
explanation.walkthrough: 'restored' rearranges ROMANS into SAMNOR, and 'to host' puts I inside.
explanation.definitionFit: The Little Bear is a constellation containing the Pole Star.

clue.text: Some fine Brie, typically being rather high

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A good Brie is usually rather strong-smelling.
explanation.definitionFit: Being high here means being tipsy, a state of drunkenness.

clue.text: Passed on German article about campus suffering setback

indicators.note: suffering setback says the whole assembly is turned round
about means the German article goes round the campus

parts.note: der is a German definite article
Yale is an American university campus

explanation.surface: News of a setback at a university was passed on in a German newspaper piece.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' signals the container and 'suffering setback' reverses the whole result, giving DEYALER read backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Relayed means passed along a message to someone else.

clue.text: Old rocker set up riot, rampaging in US city

indicators.note: set up in a down clue means the word is turned to read upwards

parts.note: a Ted, or Teddy boy, was a 1950s rock'n'roll fan

indicators.note: rampaging says the letters of riot run wild

explanation.surface: An ageing rock fan starts a violent disturbance in an American city.
explanation.walkthrough: Teddy boys were 1950s British youths in Edwardian-style suits who loved rock'n'roll.
explanation.definitionFit: Detroit is a city in Michigan, famous for cars and Motown.

clue.text: Detectable by radiation, as admitted by pupils

definitions.meaning: able to be seen or perceived

definitions.text: by radiation, as admitted by pupils
definitions.meaning: the band of radiation the eye's pupils let in is the seen part of the spectrum

explanation.definitionFit: Something detectable is perceptible to the eye, and the light pupils admit is the seen spectrum.

clue.text: Sourness very shortly seen in rising temper

parts.note: v is the short form of very

indicators.note: rising in a down clue means the word is read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: rage is a fit of temper

explanation.surface: Bitterness soon shows in a mounting temper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rising' turns RAGE upward into EGAR.
explanation.definitionFit: Vinegar is sour liquid, used figuratively for sourness of manner.

clue.text: Excitedly tuning TV to catch English game

indicators.note: to catch means the rearranged letters hold the letter for English
excitedly says the letters of tuning TV are thrown about

explanation.surface: Someone fiddles eagerly with the TV to catch an English match.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Excitedly' rearranges TUNINGTV into VINGTTUN; 'to catch' slips E between the two Ts.
explanation.definitionFit: Vingt-et-un is a card game, the French name for pontoon or blackjack.

clue.text: Permit concealing tape's origin in Panorama

indicators.note: concealing means the permit holds the next letter inside it

parts.note: a visa permits entry to a country

indicators.note: origin asks for the opening letter of tape's

explanation.surface: A licence hides the source of a tape used on a TV documentary.
explanation.walkthrough: Panorama is a long-running BBC current-affairs programme, a red herring here.
explanation.definitionFit: A vista is a broad view or prospect.

clue.text: Distinctive quality of speech showing pluck

definitions.meaning: the ringing sound of a plucked string

explanation.definitionFit: A twang is a nasal accent and also the sound of a plucked string.

clue.text: Senior chap in uniform, or a sort of suit

definitions.meaning: an army officer ranking above a captain
in bridge, spades and hearts are the higher-scoring suits

explanation.definitionFit: Major means greater, names an army rank, and in bridge describes the two high-scoring suits.

clue.text: A bit of a dive in which pot is smoked

definitions.text: A bit of a dive in which pot is smoked

parts.words: A bit of a dive in which pot is smoked
parts.note: a seedy bar is a dive, and a cannabis cigarette is what gets smoked

explanation.definitionFit: A joint is both a cheap seedy establishment and a cannabis cigarette.

clue.text: Article after article in paper that gets people steamed up

indicators.note: after puts the first article at the end
in places the second article inside the newspaper's name

parts.note: the Sun is a British tabloid newspaper
a is the indefinite article
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: An article following another in a newspaper makes readers furious.
explanation.walkthrough: The Sun is a British tabloid. 'steamed up' looks like angry, but it is literal steam.
explanation.definitionFit: A Finnish steam bath heats bathers with hot vapour.

clue.text: Maybe newspaper magazine's half lost the thread

parts.note: an organ is a publication, a newspaper being one example

indicators.note: half lost means the first four of the magazine's eight letters disappear

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written

explanation.surface: A newspaper's magazine section has lost the plot halfway through.
explanation.walkthrough: 'half lost' strips MAGA from MAGAZINE to leave ZINE.
explanation.definitionFit: Organzine is a strong twisted silk yarn used as the warp in weaving.

clue.text: Bank attacker here, so every soldier must carry one gun

indicators.note: must carry means the words for every and soldier hold the rest between them

parts.note: all means every
OR, other ranks, means ordinary soldiers
I is the Roman numeral one
gat is slang for a gun

explanation.surface: Armed soldiers are needed to guard a bank against robbers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bank' suggests a robbery, but it is a riverbank. 'must carry' puts IGAT between the two outer pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: This reptile lurks at river edges and ambushes prey from the shore.

clue.text: Posh ceremony cut short by two unknowns

indicators.note: cut short means the ceremony word loses its last letter

parts.note: a rite is a ceremony
in algebra x, y and z are unknowns, here z and y

explanation.surface: A grand ceremony is ended early by a couple of strangers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut short' takes E from RITE.
explanation.definitionFit: Ritzy means luxurious and smart, after the glamorous Ritz hotels.
